title: LP token holders on Ethereum
tagline: Two liquidity-pool tokens, every Transfer since launch, so balances, holder concentration and supply can be replayed with plain SQL. Block times are not stored in this nest, so use block numbers.

queries.title: Latest LUSD3CRV transfers
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, "from", "to", value_dec FROM lusd3crv__transfer ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Top 10 LUSD3CRV holders
queries.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT "to" AS a, value_dec AS v FROM lusd3crv__transfer UNION ALL SELECT "from", -value_dec FROM lusd3crv__transfer) SELECT a AS holder, sum(v) AS balance_base_units FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Mints and burns per 2.6M-block bucket
queries.sql: SELECT floor(block_number / 2600000) AS epoch, sum(CASE WHEN "from" = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' THEN value_dec ELSE 0 END) AS minted, sum(CASE WHEN "to" = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' THEN value_dec ELSE 0 END) AS burned FROM lusd3crv__transfer GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

queries.title: Rows per token
queries.sql: SELECT 'lusd3crv' AS token, count(*) AS transfers, min(block_number) AS first_block, max(block_number) AS last_block FROM lusd3crv__transfer UNION ALL SELECT 'univ2_usdc_usdt', count(*), min(block_number), max(block_number) FROM univ2_usdc_usdt__transfer

queries.title: Uniswap V2 USDC/USDT LP: busiest addresses
queries.sql: SELECT "to" AS address, count(*) AS received FROM univ2_usdc_usdt__transfer GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY received DESC LIMIT 10

prompts: List the top 10 holders of LP token 0xed279fdd11ca84beef15af5d39bb4d4bee23f0ca (table lusd3crv__transfer) by balance, each with its percent of total supply. Flag any holder above 5 percent.

Replay all Transfer rows of LP token 0x3041cbd36888becc7bbcbc0045e3b1f144466f5f (table univ2_usdc_usdt__transfer): sum received minus sum sent per address. Show the non-zero balances plus the 0x0 balance sum to zero.
Show how many LUSD3CRV tokens were minted (from = 0x0) and burned (to = 0x0) per block bucket of 2,600,000 blocks, and the bucket with the largest net change.
How many transfers does each of the two tokens have, and what block range does each cover?
